title: Приведенная гибкость стержня сквозного сечения

symbol_notes.lambda_y: slenderness of the complete built-up member in the plane perpendicular to y-y
symbol_notes.lambda_max: greater complete-member slenderness in the planes perpendicular to x-x or y-y
symbol_notes.lambda_b1_lambda_b2_lambda_b3: branch slendernesses between batten attachments about axes 1-1, 2-2, and 3-3
symbol_notes.A_d1_A_d2: diagonal areas in the corresponding lattice planes; for cross lattice, area of two diagonals
symbol_notes.A_d3: diagonal area in one face of an equilateral three-sided member; for cross lattice, area of two diagonals
symbol_notes.I_b1_I_b3: branch inertias about axes 1-1 and 3-3 for types 1 and 3
symbol_notes.I_b1_I_b2_type_2: inertias of two angles about axes 1-1 and 2-2 for type 2
symbol_notes.I_s: inertia of one batten about its own x-x axis for types 1 and 3
symbol_notes.I_s1_I_s2: inertias of one batten in the two corresponding planes for type 2

notes: Type 1 also includes configurations using I-sections, tubular, or other branch profiles instead of channels.
For the extended Type 1 configurations, axes y-y and 1-1 pass through the centroids of the complete section and one branch respectively.
The values n and lambda_b1 in equation (12) must be selected to produce the greatest lambda_ef.
